title: Uniform constructible domains in the fixed presentation coordinates
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $S$ with $\ell$ invertible, and a projective-line presentation $p$ [def-sp-tower-p1-adjunction-data]. For every prime $p_0\ne\ell$, field $k$ of characteristic $p_0$, and separated finite-type $k$-structure on $S$, take any section-normalized coefficient tower interfaces $a_S,a_P$. The transported uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor predicate uniform of the presentation lies in its bounded-below etale-origin domain at $S$ and $P=\mathbf P^1_S$. The recorded functors $p.F$ and $p.G$ preserve this uniform predicate. More precisely, uniform $M$ at $P$ gives domain $M$ and uniform $p.F(M)$ at $S$, and uniform $K$ at $S$ gives domain $K$ and uniform $p.G(K)$ at $P$. No tower adjunction is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the push and pullTwist clauses of the uniform-domain theorem, rewrite geometry by p.q_geometry, and apply the inverse realization to the image of the realization counit. The resulting isomorphisms identify precisely p.F and p.G. The shifted line is unchanged.

proof.text: Uniform constructible finite-Tor predicates transport along these isomorphisms with the same intervals. Map the isomorphisms through evaluation and homology; compose the same local trivializations for constructibility and use stalk linear equivalences for finite stalks. Tor tests are invariant by composing the representative isomorphisms. Thus all asserted memberships hold.

theorem towerP1_uniform_in_presentation (p : Presentation l E S hS) :
    ∀ (pchar : ℕ) [Fact pchar.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k pchar], l ≠ pchar →
    ∀ [S.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      (aS : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E S)
      (aP : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E (ProjectiveLine S)),
      (∀ M : SpTowerShriek.D l E (ProjectiveLine S),
        uniform l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S) aP M →
          domain l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S) M ∧
            uniform l E p.classes.base S aS ((p.F l E).obj M)) ∧
      (∀ K : SpTowerShriek.D l E S, uniform l E p.classes.base S aS K →
        domain l E p.classes.base S K ∧ uniform l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S) aP
          ((p.G l E).obj K))
